title.narrative: Health Information and Quality Improvement Project - Sri Lanka (01-Jul-2021-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Sri Lanka, RSSH, Ministry of Health and Mass Media of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka (MOH)This program has the following goals: Strengthening the health system which augments an effective, efficient, equitable, economical and quality health service while ensuring privacy and confidentiality of care recipients improving health outcomes.. The objectives of this program are: To provide quality and timely information for evidence-based decision making through the establishment of an ubiquitous, integrated, dynamic, cost-effective and sustainable health information system through the integration of vertical nationally scaled information systems through a digital HMIS platform.. To integrate TB Control activities into general healthcare system by establishing TB diagnostic and treatment services at base hospitals by 60% in 2021 and 100% by 2022.. Improvement of quality of care provided to the patients through improving targeted strategies in hospital quality management, improvement of quality of training of paramedical categories and laboratory investigations.

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for LKA-S-MOHP01
TB I-Other 1 TB incidence rate (estimated): Total number of new and relapsed cases notified per 100,000 population
RSSH I-other 1: Proportion of patients who are satisfied with the hospital care received.
TB I-Other 2: TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for LKA-S-MOHP01
PSM-Other 1 Percentage of consignments delivered on-time and in-full among the total number of consignments expected to be delivered for the three diseases during the reporting period
HRH-Other 1 Proportion of students graduating from a health workforce (radiographers) education and training program to the number of students enrolled in first year
SD-Other 1: Percentage of hospitals reporting quality improvement data through the Quality Performance Evaluation Tool (QPET)
LAB -Other 1 Percentage of laboratories showing adequate performance in external quality assurance for smear microscopy during the reporting period.
Percentage of facilities which record and submit data using the electronic information system
SD Other 2: Percentage of verifiable Primary Medical Care Institutions (PMCIs) covered by quarterly supportive quality supervision visits (at least three supervisions per year)
Outcome indicators targets and results for LKA-S-MOHP01
RSSH O- Other 2 Proportion of hospitals able to digitally request and share data with Medical Research Institute (MRI) through LMIS

National aggregate HMIS fully deployed and functional: Percentage of HMIS components in place (HIS deployment, completeness, timeliness, and integration of aggregate disease reporting for HIV, TB and malaria indicators)
RSSH O- Other 1 Number of PMCIs that use personal health records to coordinate patient care over time and through the referral chain
